kind: bounded reduction CPU/allocation optimization; same-precision primary baseline and explicitly inexact historical reference
methodology: Identical release probe source and dependency locks for three variants. Allocator-disabled ABCCBA twice gives four fresh processes/version, one warmup and five samples/case. Separate allocator-enabled builds. No agent-owned builds/checks run during measurement. Actual aggregate process CPU uses CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID via checked benchmark-only libc clock_gettime and includes timestamp overhead. Small-case granularity/scheduling noise makes these diagnostics, not acceptance thresholds. Raw calls include input validation; immutable validated wrappers are prepared outside timing. Field certificates, arithmetic selection, membership and scratch remain timed. Construction, schema/conditioned numeric checks and destruction are excluded. Timed checks use tolerance 1e-12 on bounded data and are not precision gates; independent Python Fraction fixtures and public regressions supply precision acceptance. Grids have 8/16/24 cubed points with hexahedra and scalar/vector point fields; decimation uses two-unit cubes. Statistics additionally uses 48 cubed points. Modes are positive quantized, spatially separated signs, mixed quantized and deterministic mixed full 53-bit fractions. fd9eaefc is the same-precision baseline. 7dd24e2c loses adversarial residuals and can round differently: it is only a historical cost reference and never evidence of correctness equivalence. Shared host without controlled affinity/thermal state. CPU is not energy; allocations are cumulative calls/bytes, not peak/live/RSS or mobile qualification. Unrelated operations may fluctuate; no whole-frame/device acceptance claim.
